neighbours.label: the '-m' piece that starts the second half of a hyphenated English compound (low-maintenance, heart-melting, e-magazine), as against hyphenated compounds whose second half starts with another letter
fire: This shrub is fairly low-maintenance once it is established.
The film ends with a truly heart-melting reunion at the airport.
Our club now publishes a monthly e-magazine for its members.
The village clinic ran an anti-malaria campaign last year.
Researchers studied the semi-molten rock beneath the volcano.
The cake was topped with half-melted chocolate and nuts.
They sell pre-mixed paints at the Saturday market.
The plan is a long-missed chance to fix the old bridge.
